response.rationale: Multiple T1 meta-analyses and reviews (Rowland 2014, Adesope 2017, Roediger & Karpicke 2006, Dunlosky 2013) show retrieval practice yields more durable retention than restudy, and the one negative item (Latimier 2021) only compares spaced schedules, so it doesn't contradict the hypothesis; some positive items are duplicated or restated, which slightly lowers the effective evidence count.
